hero.headline: Software built around how your business actually runs.
hero.description: Inventory systems, calculators, quotation and billing tools, custom workflow software — modeled on your real process, not a generic template.

statement: Most software is built for people who already think in software. We build for people who think in stock, batches and quotes — and make the software disappear into how they already work.

painPoints.title: If any of this sounds familiar, that's the kind of problem we solve.
items: Quotes get calculated by hand, or in a spreadsheet only one person understands.
Stock is tracked across notebooks, WhatsApp messages, and memory.
The same report gets rebuilt manually, every single week.
Invoices don't quite match what compliance actually requires.

solutions.name: Inventory & Stock Systems
solutions.tagline: Know what you have, where it is, and where it's going.
solutions.description: Raw material, batches and finished stock tracked the way your production actually moves — not a generic stock-keeping template. Proven across multiple stages of aluminium manufacturing; built to fit any production or trading operation.

solutions.name: Calculators & Estimators
solutions.tagline: Turn a manual calculation into an instant, accurate one.
solutions.description: When pricing or planning depends on a formula — material, wastage, dimensions, margin — we build the tool that does it in seconds instead of a notebook full of maths.

solutions.name: Quotation & Billing
solutions.tagline: Professional quotes, compliant invoices, sent faster.
solutions.description: From a priced quotation to a tax-compliant invoice, with your numbering, your terms, and your branding — without retyping anything twice.

solutions.name: Custom Operational Software
solutions.tagline: Everything in between, built around your process.
solutions.description: If it's not on this list, it's probably the next thing we build — any workflow that's still running on spreadsheets, paper, or a system that doesn't quite fit.

process.title: Coordination
process.description: We start by understanding how you actually work — not by pitching a template.

process.title: Demo
process.description: We show you a working version built around your process, not a generic mockup.

process.title: Trial
process.description: You use it in your real operations before committing to anything.

process.title: Iterate
process.description: We keep refining until it fits the way you actually work — until you're satisfied.

process.title: Stay connected
process.description: We keep asking for feedback after launch. It doesn't end at delivery.

whyUs.title: We stay involved after launch
whyUs.description: This isn't a build-and-disappear model — we keep coming back for feedback and keep improving what we've built.

whyUs.title: We go deep on your workflow, not wide on generic features
whyUs.description: Every business's version of "inventory" or "quoting" is different — we build around your specific reality instead of a one-size-fits-all template.

whyUs.title: Coordination-first
whyUs.description: Every engagement starts with understanding your process. You see a demo, you trial it in real operations, and we iterate until it fits.

reach: Working with businesses across Gujarat and Chhattisgarh — from Anand, Vadodara, Jamnagar and Junagadh to Rajkot.
